trace: In the 1989 paper, the UNSW laboratory team reported a PERC cell with independently confirmed conversion efficiency up to 22.8% (unsw-passivated-emitter-and-rear-solar-cell).

LONGi’s 2017 Hi-MO2 reworked the rear-passivated cell layout with bifacial PERC cells and a transparent rear package (longi-hi-mo2-bifacial-perc-module). The canonical adapts link is limited to cell-design lineage. Dullweber et al. independently document the adaptation from the UNSW concept to industrial bifacial PERC and list LONGi’s commercial implementation.

Georgia Power selected a Camilla solar project from its 2017 REDI procurement and signed with Invenergy subsidiary Camilla Solar Energy LLC. The 2020 Southern Oak service entry with Hi-MO2 panels is an adoption event on longi-hi-mo2-bifacial-perc-module. An August 2026 EIA observation follows the same plant.

In 2013 Fraunhofer ISE reported a full-area rear passivating contact on a 24% n-type lab cell (fraunhofer-tunnel-oxide-passivated-contact-solar-cell). The commercial Tiger Neo 3.0 shipment evidence confirms the alternative architecture reached volume shipment. The route from the Freiburg lab to particular manufacturers remains open.
alternatives: TOPCon provides a competing rear-contact strategy. Fraunhofer ISE’s 2013 announcement explains the trade-off of local contacts in higher-efficiency cells and describes an approach that passivates and contacts the full rear area (release 31/13, pp. 1–2).

ISFH’s bifacial PERC+ paper contrasts the route with n-type PERT, which typically used screened silver fingers on both sides and different doping steps (Dullweber et al., 2017, pp. 46–47). This is a device and manufacturing comparison under the documented process assumptions.
frontier: Read UNSW’s NERDDP Project 81/1264 final report and 4th PVSEC proceedings to date the original design and earlier working cells.
Locate named license agreements, equipment supplier process documents or factory reports to trace LONGi’s adoption of industrial PERC and establish its production location.
Find plant maintenance or repowering records to verify which modules contributed to Southern Oak’s provisional August 2026 generation.
Check earlier tunnel-oxide and polysilicon passivated-contact papers cited by Feldmann’s group and then identify named pilot and transfer records for commercial TOPCon.
screen: Checked the pinned discovery files, actual event arrays and typed links for Bell’s silicon cell, Vanguard I power and Bangladesh solar home systems, plus leads for PERC, TOPCon, photovoltaics and solar power. Bell, Vanguard and Bangladesh describe distinct achievements. The Southern Oak equipment installation extends the Hi-MO2 record. The solar thermal leads concern a separate route.
coverage: Selected laboratory cell, module product, installation and factory shipment observations. Historical release or reporting dates supply upper bounds where applicable. Evidence read through 17 November 2026. The latest observed generation month is August 2026 and the latest evidenced shipment period is the third quarter of 2026.
